name: Manus
summary: General-purpose AI agent that executes tasks end to end.
description: Manus is an autonomous AI agent that goes beyond answering questions to carry out tasks such as in-depth research, building websites and producing slides. It stands out for parallel 'Wide Research' and scheduled tasks running in the cloud. A free plan gives 300 daily refresh credits (Lite agent mode, capped monthly) plus signup credits, and paid plans add monthly credit pools from 4,000 credits.
